description: A trip letter: up to four nights at named camps from the records (free first, then unpriced, said so), a town run on day 3 with the recorded fuel, water and grocery, each camp's cost, stay limit, water, toilet and season for the date. Give forest_slug (a national forest) or town. start_date defaults to today; no night is put on a camp the record reads closed on that date, and a mostly-closed forest gets the earliest date its records say a camp opens. For the four places the game holds it adds a play link and a prompt with the plan folded in. All distances straight-line.

town.description: A town to plan around, like "Quartzsite" (use for BLM land).

name: plan_four_nights
title: Plan a four-night trip from the records
